slides.headline: You're missing benefits because the system is too complex
White House launches benefit-finding chatbot pilot
slides.body: A new AI assistant guides people through federal programs like SNAP, Medicaid, and veterans' aid without needing a caseworker.

slides.headline: Types your situation, gets plain-language steps
slides.body: Describe your income, family size, and zip code — the bot returns which programs you qualify for and exactly how to apply.

slides.headline: But it can hallucinate eligibility rules
slides.body: Early tests show the chatbot sometimes invents deadlines or misses state-specific rules, risking denied applications or lost benefits.

slides.headline: Your data feeds the model unless you opt out
slides.body: Conversations are stored to improve the system; sensitive financial and health details stay on government servers but may train future versions.

slides.headline: Want simpler government help?
slides.body: Follow for AI that affects your wallet, not just your code.
